description: Render a URL in headless Chromium and return the fully-executed HTML (after JavaScript runs) — use this when a plain fetch returns an empty shell or JS-rendered SPA. Example: browserless_content({ url: "https://example.com", _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: Browserless API token (sign up at https://www.browserless.io/signup)

url.description: The page URL to render, e.g. "https://example.com"

waitForTimeout.description: Optional milliseconds to wait after load before capturing HTML (lets late JS settle), e.g. 3000

name: browserless_content
title: Browserless Content
